correctness.rationale: Exact inclusion-exclusion plus uniform truncation establishes the expansion. The bounds use factorial dominance q_(n,k)^m <= exp(-2mk/n); the Taylor remainder summed against Poisson weights is O(log²n/n²). Three alternating exponential sums give the signed coefficient. Exact DP and high-precision checks corroborate the derivation.
